payload.answer: As of the cutoff, officials intended to retain the contractor and drain at least part of the pool during the week of July 5. The supplier described weeks of work and claimed waterproofing remained intact; this is not independently verified. Peeling had recurred after the initial restoration and no firm completion date was reported by July 6. Plaintiffs had reserved the right to seek further injunctive relief; no active stop order was established by our retrieved record.

coverage.interpretation: Peeling after initial renovation, plans for renewed drainage/repair, no announced firm date.
Same contractor selected; government commitment and pending legal dispute.
Defects recurred; statements about small repair scope remain interested-party claims; litigation could impede work.
